text: Commander. I do not fight unnecessary battles. Only wars I can win.
Commander. So I am the first comrade in a hundred years — what an honor. Small craft are my specialty; I'll take you anywhere.
England expects— no. Now Earth expects. Let us begin, Commander.
A location even the Cheeks could not find — Proxima B, perturbed by the Gliese Rift. The Commander's awakening point.
Commander, you said? I have waited for one who would reclaim my land. Speak — what is your wish?
Commander — the final command is yours.
